_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.balanced: Balanced teams need mixed damage, durable switch-ins, flexible positioning, and at least one reliable speed plan.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.offense: Offense needs several immediate attackers, spread pressure, and enough speed or priority to keep tempo.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.bulky offense: Bulky Offense combines sustained damage with durable pieces, recovery or pivots, and speed control.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.hyper offense: Hyper Offense needs nearly every slot applying pressure plus layered speed and priority.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.stall: Stall needs repeated recovery, protection, disruption, and enough bulk to win long board states.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.semi-stall: Semi-Stall needs a durable control core without giving up all proactive damage.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.goodstuff: Goodstuff teams need independently strong attackers backed by varied utility and safe positioning.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.trick room: Trick Room teams need redundant setters and several slow attackers that convert the limited turns.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.tailwind: Tailwind teams need redundant setters and fast attackers that exploit the speed window immediately.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.rain: Rain teams need reliable weather access, several beneficiaries, and no competing weather plan.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.sun: Sun teams need reliable weather access, several beneficiaries, and no competing weather plan.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.sand: Sand teams need a setter, several compatible beneficiaries, and a clear payoff for the weather.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.snow: Snow teams need a setter, Ice or Aurora Veil synergy, and no competing weather plan.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.terrain: Terrain teams need a dependable setter and multiple slots or moves that convert the field effect.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.screens: Screens teams need redundant screen access, Light Clay support, and setup or offensive payoffs.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.setup: Setup teams need multiple win conditions and protection through redirection, disruption, or screens.
_V403_ARCHETYPE_DESCRIPTIONS.perish trap: Perish Trap needs Perish Song, redundant trapping, protection, and tools to rotate or sustain the board.
